snippet.title: G.E.M. Grab & Exit - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
G.E.M. Grab & Exit is a hand-drawn twin-stick shooter set in space where one must survive the robotic ships onslaught and extract with the loot to exchange for ship upgrades.

Coming Soon on steam and itch.io

http:// store.steampowered.com/app/3458290/GEM_Grab__Exit/
